name: protoform-core
title: Protoform core
description: Framework-free field model, Standard Schema integration, and form-library validation adapters.

export {
  type FieldConfig,
  type EmptyRepeatedStringPolicy,
  type FieldRenderHints,
  type FormValues,
  getFieldHints,
  type InputProps,
  type OptionGroup,
  type ParsedField,
  type ParsedSchema,
  type ProviderCustomData,
  type Renderable,
  type SchemaProvider,
  type SchemaValidation,
  type SchemaValidationContext,
  type SchemaValidationError,
  type UiRule,
} from "./field-model.js";
export {
  createFinalFormValidator,
  createFormikValidator,
  type FormValidationErrors,
  type FormValidator,
  type FormValidatorOptions,
  standardSchemaIssuesToFormErrors,
} from "./form-library-adapters.js";
export { isStandardSchema, type StandardSchemaV1 } from "./standard-schema.js";
